items.title: Families of slain cops call off Quetta sit-in after government assures of probing recent attacks

items.title: Dubai Basketball adds French Championship MVP Elie Okobo to roster
items.description: DUBAI: French guard Elie Okobo will play for Dubai Basketball after reaching an agreement with the team on a multi-year deal. The 28-year-old joins from AS Monaco, where he spent the past four seasons (2022-26), following a one-year stint with fellow French side LDLC ASVEL (2021-22). He becomes the latest addition to Dubai Basketball’s roster ahead of the 2026-27 campaign.

items.description: DRAMMEN: A major fire in southern Norway destroyed more than 100 homes Friday and forced hundreds of people to evacuate the area, according to police and the country’s public broadcaster. items.title: Ukrainian drones hit warehouses and other sites across Russia, killing 9 and wounding over 80
items.description: Ukrainian drones struck two sprawling warehouses, one of them just east of Moscow, as part of attacks overnight and on Saturday afternoon that killed nine people and wounded more than 80, Russian officials said.
